gaps.sentence: She wishes she ___ the job offer when it came.
gaps.explanation: Regret about a past decision takes the past perfect: had accepted.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ how to play the piano.
gaps.hint: wish plus past for present regret
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus past simple expresses regret about a present situation: knew.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ below five degrees tonight, the event will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple even when referring to tonight: drops.

gaps.sentence: I wish you ___ your shoes in the middle of the floor!
gaps.hint: irritation about a habit, wish would
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus 'would' expresses irritation about a habit you want changed: would not leave.

gaps.sentence: She keeps a spare key at her mother's in case she ___ herself out.
gaps.hint: a precaution, in case plus present
gaps.explanation: 'In case' clauses use the present simple for possible future problems: locks.

gaps.sentence: He wishes he ___ harder at school when he had the chance.
gaps.hint: past regret, wish plus past perfect
gaps.explanation: Regret about past behavior takes the past perfect after 'wish': had worked.

gaps.sentence: She'd be a great lawyer if she ___ more patient.
gaps.explanation: Second conditional with 'be': 'were' for all persons.

gaps.sentence: ___ harder, she would have passed the exam.
gaps.hint: inversion replaces if in formal English
gaps.explanation: Formal English can drop 'if' and invert: Had she studied harder, she would have passed.
